disclaimer: All brands, models, capabilities, numbers, and placements are illustrative, not manufacturer-verified.
layout_coordinate_convention: Each motherboard connector layout uses x,y,w,h in 0-100 percentages of a top-down board image; approximate and fictional.
notes: DDR4 and DDR5 UDIMMs both have 288 pins but are not interchangeable.
PCIe slot physical lanes can differ from electrical lanes.
USB headers are motherboard-side connectors, not external USB ports.
RGB_12V_4PIN and ARGB_5V_3PIN are intentionally incompatible.
Power draw is a rough gameplay estimate, not an electrical engineering model.
Motherboard layout is approximate and not dimensionally accurate.
